messages:
Maya Chen: quick sync — QBR prep for PocketWatch. They surfaced an unexpected embed-heavy batch job overnight; retainer burn jumped. onboarding checklist looks mostly green but missing two enablement demos. can we map risk + quick mitigations?
Jared Roberts: saw the spike around 03:40 UTC, ~95k embed tokens in a 4-hr window, mostly /embed-bulk. Dashboard: https://internal.redwood/usage/pocketwatch (internal)
Priya Singh: moving renewal risk to amber for QBR narrative. they want a clear 30/60/90 spend forecast and what we'll do if inflight spikes continue.
Sam Ortiz: quick mitigations: 1) add spend alert at 75% retainer 2) temp throttle batch_size 512->128 for 48h 3) turn on prefix caching for frequent chat queries. low-risk.
Sam Ortiz: example alert rule to add in Console -> Alerts:
```
resource: customer/pocketwatch
metric: credits_used
window: 24h
threshold: 75%
notify: #cs-team, #ops-oncall
action: temp-throttle embed_batch_size=128
```
Jared Roberts: also recommend applying quantization profile q4_0 on their model variant to reduce cost ~18%. I will run perf validation in staging and report.
Priya Singh: for the QBR deck I need: current burn rate, 30/60/90 projection scenarios (baseline, conservative, worst-case), mitigations we implemented, and customer feedback notes. Maya — can you capture enablement gaps and run a short poll with their team?
Maya Chen: will collect enablement notes and run a quick poll first thing. I'll own feedback capture and add slide content.
CS-Bot: alert created: pocketwatch credits_used 75% threshold (1991001800) — notified #cs-ops.
Maya Chen: owner checklist:
- Sam: implement temp throttle & caching (ETA 2h)
- Jared: validate quantization perf (ETA EOD)
- Maya: capture enablement gaps + customer poll (ETA tomorrow AM)
- Priya: assemble burn scenarios and slides (ETA EOD)
Maya Chen: will update thread after poll results. :white_check_mark:
